thread:
Nina (product): FYI launching v3.4.1-priv onprem feature: Scoped Operator Profiles (delegated ops) — opt-in for Private/VPC customers. Enables role-scoped operator identities, emergency host fallback, and local signed audit bundles.

Nina (product): This is targeted at customers with stricter compliance needs; migration is optional and dry-run supported.

DeployBot: Rollout started: v3.4.1-priv-scoped-ops -> canary eu-west-1 at 3605008200

Omar (eng): Implementation detail: operator profiles map to SSO roles or to short-lived certs if SSO unavailable. We emit rotation hints and cert expiry metrics to the Console.

Harper (security): Compliance note: audit bundles include signed operator session manifests + integrity hashes. Recommend KMS/HSM for key storage and 90-day operator key rotation for higher-assurance customers.

Jules (docs): I'll draft a KB with a migration checklist and CLI examples. Any preferred snippet formats?

Nina (product): Use these minimal CLI examples:
```
# simulate migration
redwoodctl access migrate --to delegated --dry-run

# enable with 72h emergency fallback and signed bundles
redwoodctl policies set --delegated-ops true --emergency-window 72h --signed-audit true
```

Felix (sales): Can you give me a 2-line customer blurb for outreach?

Nina (product): Customer blurb: "Scoped Operator Profiles let your infra teams perform operator tasks without sharing long-lived credentials. All activity is recorded locally with signed attestations for audits. Migration is opt-in and supports dry-runs."

Omar (eng): Fallback behavior: when delegated auth fails, we switch to the configured emergency host operator for the configured window and log the event. Fallbacks raise Console alerts and show in the audit bundle.

DeployBot: Canary complete at 3605008480, monitoring 1h for error/regressions.

Harper (security): Add a short note in KB about verifying audit bundle signatures for customers doing offline evidence checks.

Jules (docs): Will include verification steps and the CLI snippets.

Felix (sales): I'll start pilot outreach after docs land.

Nina (product): Action list: Nina publish announcement + compliance blurb; Jules KB + CLI; Omar run staging migration; Harper KMS/HSM guidance; Felix pilot outreach. Please :thumbsup: when done.
